info.title: API.SH: AllTrails
info.description: The AllTrails API from API.SH: public AllTrails data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: AllTrails park or place with its trails
get.description:
An AllTrails park, city, state, country or point of interest (lake, peak, waterfall...) by link, with its details (`kind`, `type_label`, `location`, coordinates, `bounds`, `trails_count`, the activities, features and difficulties of its trails, guides, curated lists) and its trails (`trails.items`, with the same filters as /alltrails/v1/search). Pass `trails.next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/alltrails-place

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Place link or path, e.g. `parks/us/california/yosemite-national-park`, `us/california/yosemite-valley`, `us/california`, `poi/us/colorado/estes-park/emerald-lake`; or a park id.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords to narrow the place's trails.

parameters.name: difficulty
parameters.description: easy, moderate, hard, strenuous; comma separated for several.

parameters.name: activities
parameters.description: Any of these activities, comma separated: hiking, walking, trail-running, mountain-biking, road-biking, backpacking, camping, birding, fishing, horseback-riding, rock-climbing, skiing, cross-country-skiing, snowshoeing, scenic-driving, paddle-sports, off-road-driving, via-ferrata.

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: Features every trail must have, comma separated: dogs, dogs-leash, dogs-no, kids, ada, strollers, paved, partially-paved, views, waterfall, lake, river, beach, forest, cave, wild-flowers, wildlife, hot-springs, historic-site, rails-trails, city-walk.

parameters.name: park_id
parameters.description: Trails in this park (id from /alltrails/v1/places or a trail's `park`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. The site lists at most 1,000 results per search.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Parks, cities, states, countries, points of interest and lists on AllTrails by name: `id`, `kind`, `type_label`, `name`, `url`, `location`, coordinates, `state`, `country`, `trails_count` and `raw`. The ids feed the place filters of /alltrails/v1/search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/alltrails-places

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: park, city, state, country, poi, list; comma separated (default all but lists).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Trails on AllTrails (alltrails.com) for keywords, with the explore page's filters: difficulty, length, elevation gain, route type, activities, features, rating, open trails only, park, city, state, country, and distance from a point (`lat`, `lng`, `radius_km`; results then carry `distance_km`, nearest first). Each trail: `id`, `name`, `url`, `location`, `park`, `city`, `state`, `country`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `rating`, `reviews`, `photos`, `difficulty`, `route_type`, `length_km`, `length_mi`, `elevation_gain_m`, `elevation_gain_ft`, `highest_point_m`, `activities`, `features`, `closed`, `description`, `photo`, `monthly_popularity` and `raw`. Also `total` and `applied_filters`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/alltrails-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (trail, park or place name), e.g. `half dome`. Optional when a place filter or `lat`/`lng` is given.

parameters.name: difficulty
parameters.description: easy, moderate, hard, strenuous; comma separated for several.

parameters.name: activities
parameters.description: Any of these activities, comma separated: hiking, walking, trail-running, mountain-biking, road-biking, backpacking, camping, birding, fishing, horseback-riding, rock-climbing, skiing, cross-country-skiing, snowshoeing, scenic-driving, paddle-sports, off-road-driving, via-ferrata.

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: Features every trail must have, comma separated: dogs, dogs-leash, dogs-no, kids, ada, strollers, paved, partially-paved, views, waterfall, lake, river, beach, forest, cave, wild-flowers, wildlife, hot-springs, historic-site, rails-trails, city-walk.

parameters.name: park_id
parameters.description: Trails in this park (id from /alltrails/v1/places or a trail's `park`).

parameters.name: city_id
parameters.description: Trails near this city (id from /alltrails/v1/places or a trail's `city`).

parameters.name: state_id
parameters.description: Trails in this state or region (e.g. `5` for California).

parameters.name: country_id
parameters.description: Trails in this country (e.g. `313` for the United States).

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of a point: trails around it, nearest first.

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Search radius around the point in km (default 25, max 500).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. The site lists at most 1,000 results per search.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/alltrails-trail

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/alltrails-trail-photos

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Trail id (e.g. `10005585`) or its alltrails.com/trail/ link.

get.description:
Reviews of an AllTrails trail, newest first: `id`, `rating`, `text`, `language`, `date`, `activity`, `conditions` (e.g. muddy, icy), `rating_tags`, `obstacles`, `author` (username, name, profile link, photo), `recording` and `raw`. Filter by star rating. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/alltrails-trail-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Trail id (e.g. `10005585`) or its alltrails.com/trail/ link.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars (1-5).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
